summary.en: A former actress, possibly born in Cyprus or Syria and raised among the Hippodrome entertainers, Theodora married Justinian in about 525 and was crowned empress with him in 527. She protected the Miaphysites, promoted laws for women and is credited with saving his throne during the Nika riots.

summary.en: Son of the exarch of Africa, Heraclius sailed from Carthage and overthrew Phocas in 610. After Persia took Syria, Jerusalem and Egypt, he campaigned deep into Persia and won at Nineveh in 627, restoring the True Cross to Jerusalem, only to lose the same provinces to the Arab conquests in the 630s.

summary.en: The longest-reigning Byzantine emperor (976–1025) crushed aristocratic revolts with the help of Varangian troops sent by Vladimir of Kiev, whom he gave his sister Anna in marriage. summary.en: Born Constantine in Thessaloniki, he taught philosophy in Constantinople and served on embassies to the Abbasids and the Khazars. With his brother Methodius he led the mission to Great Moravia in 863, inventing the Glagolitic alphabet; he took the monastic name Cyril shortly before his death in Rome.

summary.en: Widow of Prince Igor, Olga ruled Kievan Rus' for her son Sviatoslav. The Primary Chronicle tells of her elaborate revenge on the Drevlians who had killed Igor, and of her tax reforms. Baptised in Constantinople in the 950s, she was the first ruler of Rus' to become a Christian and was later venerated as a saint.
summary.zh: 奥尔加是伊戈尔大公的遗孀，代儿子斯维亚托斯拉夫统治基辅罗斯。《往年纪事》记载了她如何精心报复杀害伊戈尔的德列夫利安人，以及她的赋税改革。她于950年代在君士坦丁堡受洗，是第一位皈依基督教的罗斯统治者，后被尊为圣徒。

note: Her birth year is unknown (dates from c. 890 to the 920s are proposed); the revenge stories are legendary, and the date of her baptism (c. 955 or 957) is debated.

story.en:
According to the Primary Chronicle, compiled about 150 years after her death, the Drevlians killed Olga's husband Igor in 945 when he returned to collect a second tribute, and then sent envoys proposing that she marry their prince. The chronicle tells of three revenges: the first envoys were buried alive in their boat, the second burned in a bathhouse, and at the Drevlian town of Iskorosten she asked for a tribute of three pigeons and three sparrows from every house, tied burning tinder to the birds and set the town alight.

The tales are legend, but the chronicle also credits her with fixing tribute and trading posts, a real reform. Byzantine court records describe her reception in Constantinople, where she was baptised. Her son Sviatoslav stayed pagan, but her grandson Vladimir made Christianity the religion of Rus'.
story.zh:
据成书于她去世约一百五十年后的《往年纪事》记载，945年伊戈尔前去第二次征收贡赋时被德列夫利安人杀死，对方随后派使者向奥尔加提亲，要她嫁给他们的王公。编年史讲述了她的三次复仇：第一批使者连船被活埋，第二批在浴室中被烧死；在德列夫利安人的城镇伊斯科罗斯坚，她要求每户进贡三只鸽子和三只麻雀，然后在鸟身上绑上燃着的火绒放飞，把全城付之一炬。

这些故事属于传说，但编年史也记载她确定了贡赋额和征税站点，这是一项真实的改革。拜占庭宫廷文献记录了她在君士坦丁堡受到接见并受洗的情形。她的儿子斯维亚托斯拉夫仍信奉多神教，而孙子弗拉基米尔则使基督教成为罗斯的宗教。

summary.en: Son of Sviatoslav, Vladimir won Kiev in a war against his brothers with Varangian help. After sending envoys to compare religions, he accepted Byzantine Christianity around 988, married the emperor's sister Anna and had the people of Kiev baptised in the Dnieper, setting the religious course of Rus'.
summary.zh: 弗拉基米尔是斯维亚托斯拉夫之子，借瓦良格人之助在与兄弟的战争中夺得基辅。据载他派使者考察各种宗教后，约988年接受拜占庭基督教，迎娶皇帝之妹安娜，并让基辅民众在第聂伯河中受洗，从而决定了罗斯的宗教方向。

summary.en: Born Vajk, son of Grand Prince Géza, Stephen was crowned the first king of Hungary around 1000. He defeated pagan rivals, organised the realm into counties and bishoprics with archbishoprics at Esztergom and Kalocsa, and was canonised in 1083 as Hungary's patron saint.

summary.en: Grand Duke of pagan Lithuania, Jogaila agreed at Krewo in 1385 to convert and marry Queen Jadwiga, becoming King Władysław II of Poland in 1386. With his cousin Vytautas he crushed the Teutonic Order at Grunwald in 1410, and his Jagiellonian dynasty ruled much of Central Europe for nearly two centuries.

In 1443 he deserted, seized Krujë and formed the League of Lezhë, holding off Ottoman armies, including two sultans, for 25 years. He is Albania's national hero.

story.en:
As a boy George Kastrioti was handed over by his father, an Albanian lord, as a hostage to Sultan Murad II. Raised at the Ottoman court, he converted to Islam and became a cavalry commander, known as Iskender Bey, "Lord Alexander". In November 1443, during the Christian victory at Niš, he deserted with a band of Albanians, reached Krujë with a forged order from the sultan, took the fortress and proclaimed a return to Christianity.

The next year at Lezhë he united the Albanian nobles in a league and defeated an Ottoman army at Torvioll. For twenty-five years he used the mountains, fast cavalry and Venetian, Neapolitan and papal help to beat back invasion after invasion; Murad II in 1450 and Mehmed II in 1466 both failed before Krujë. He died of fever at Lezhë in 1468, and Krujë fell ten years later. His helmet with a goat's head crest is kept in Vienna.
story.zh:
格尔吉·卡斯特里奥蒂幼年被身为阿尔巴尼亚领主的父亲送给苏丹穆拉德二世作人质。他在奥斯曼宫廷长大，改信伊斯兰教，成为骑兵将领，人称“伊斯坎德尔贝伊”，即“亚历山大大人”。1443年11月基督徒在尼什获胜时，他率一队阿尔巴尼亚人倒戈，凭一道伪造的苏丹命令进入克鲁亚，夺取要塞并宣布重归基督教。

次年他在莱什把阿尔巴尼亚贵族联合为同盟，并在托尔维奥尔击败一支奥斯曼军队。二十五年间，他借助山地、快速骑兵以及威尼斯、那不勒斯和教廷的援助，一次次击退入侵；1450年的穆拉德二世和1466年的穆罕默德二世都在克鲁亚城下铩羽而归。1468年他在莱什因热病去世，十年后克鲁亚陷落。他那顶饰有山羊头的头盔今天收藏在维也纳。

summary.en: Ivan III "the Great" annexed Novgorod in 1478 and Tver in 1485, stopped paying tribute to the Horde after the stand on the Ugra in 1480, and styled himself sovereign of all Russia. Married to Sophia Palaiologina, niece of the last Byzantine emperor, he had Italian architects rebuild the Moscow Kremlin.
summary.zh: 伊凡三世“大帝”于1478年吞并诺夫哥罗德、1485年吞并特维尔，1480年乌格拉河对峙后停止向汗国纳贡，自称“全罗斯君主”。他娶末代拜占庭皇帝的侄女索菲娅·帕列奥罗格为妻，并延请意大利建筑师重建莫斯科克里姆林宫。

summary.en: Grand prince at three, Ivan IV was crowned the first tsar of Russia in 1547. His early reforms and conquest of Kazan and Astrakhan gave way to the long Livonian War, the terror of the oprichnina and the sack of Novgorod. In 1581 he killed his heir in a rage, leaving the throne to his feeble son Fyodor.
summary.zh: 伊凡四世三岁即大公位，1547年加冕为俄国第一位沙皇。他早年推行改革、征服喀山和阿斯特拉罕，后来却陷入漫长的利沃尼亚战争、特辖制恐怖和对诺夫哥罗德的洗劫。1581年他盛怒之下杀死了继承人，把皇位留给体弱的儿子费奥多尔。

summary.en: A registered Cossack officer, Khmelnytsky led the great uprising of 1648 against Polish rule and founded the Cossack Hetmanate in central Ukraine. sources.title: George G. Grabowicz, The Poet as Mythmaker (1982)

story.en:
Shevchenko grew up an orphaned serf boy on the estate of the landowner Pavel Engelhardt, who noticed his drawing and took him to St Petersburg as a house painter. There the painter Ivan Soshenko introduced him to Karl Bryullov and the poet Vasily Zhukovsky. In 1838 they raffled a portrait of Zhukovsky painted by Bryullov and used the 2,500 roubles to buy Shevchenko's freedom.

Two years later his first collection, Kobzar, named after the wandering minstrels of Ukraine, showed that Ukrainian could be a language of high poetry. His verses attacking serfdom and the tsar led to his arrest in 1847; Nicholas I personally added the order that he be forbidden to write and paint. Released in 1857, he died in St Petersburg a week after his 47th birthday, days before the serfs were emancipated, and was reburied on a hill above the Dnieper at Kaniv.
story.zh:
舍甫琴科自幼父母双亡，是地主帕维尔·恩格尔哈特庄园里的农奴孩子。地主发现他擅长绘画，便把他带到圣彼得堡当油漆匠。在那里，画家伊万·索申科把他介绍给卡尔·布留洛夫和诗人瓦西里·茹科夫斯基。1838年，他们把布留洛夫所画的茹科夫斯基肖像拿去抽彩，用所得的2500卢布为舍甫琴科赎了身。

两年后，他以乌克兰流浪歌手命名的第一部诗集《科布扎歌手》问世，证明乌克兰语可以成为高雅诗歌的语言。他抨击农奴制和沙皇的诗作使他在1847年被捕，尼古拉一世亲笔加上禁止他写作和绘画的命令。1857年获释后，他在47岁生日后一周死于圣彼得堡，距农奴解放仅有数日，后被迁葬于卡尼夫第聂伯河畔的山冈上。

summary.en: A Georgian seminarian turned Bolshevik revolutionary, Stalin rose through the party apparatus as general secretary after 1922 and ruled the USSR from the late 1920s until his death. He forced collectivisation and industrialisation, conducted the Great Purge, led the Soviet war against Nazi Germany and imposed communist regimes on Eastern Europe.
summary.zh: 斯大林原是格鲁吉亚的神学院学生，后成为布尔什维克革命者，1922年后以总书记身份在党内机构中崛起，从20世纪20年代末统治苏联直至去世。他强制推行集体化和工业化，发动大清洗，领导苏联对纳粹德国的战争，并在东欧强加共产党政权。

summary.en: An absurdist playwright banned after 1968, Havel co-founded the human-rights manifesto Charter 77 and wrote the essay The Power of the Powerless, spending almost five years in prison. He led Civic Forum in the Velvet Revolution and was the last president of Czechoslovakia and first president of the Czech Republic.
summary.zh: 哈维尔是荒诞派剧作家，1968年后作品被禁。他参与发起人权宣言《七七宪章》，写下《无权者的权力》，前后坐牢近五年。他在天鹅绒革命中领导“公民论坛”，是捷克斯洛伐克最后一任总统和捷克共和国首任总统。

role.en: Last leader of the Soviet Union

summary.en: General secretary from 1985, Gorbachev launched glasnost (openness) and perestroika (restructuring), withdrew from Afghanistan, signed arms-control treaties and let the Eastern European revolutions of 1989 take their course. He won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1990 and resigned as the USSR dissolved in December 1991.
summary.zh: 戈尔巴乔夫1985年出任总书记，推行“公开性”和“改革”，从阿富汗撤军，签署军备控制条约，并对1989年东欧革命采取不干预态度。他于1990年获诺贝尔和平奖，1991年12月苏联解体时辞职。
